title: LIMS Implementation Support Engineer (6-Month Temporary Contract)
description: Company Description Eurofins is the world’s leading laboratory group in the field of food and feed testing. With its state‑of‑the‑art equipment and advanced analytical techniques, it offers a wide portfolio of tests to help its customers meet their ever‑increasing quality standards. Job Description Local project support — serve as the on‑site point of contact for Project Manager implementation activities, ensuring alignment between the lab and global project teams. Business requirements analysis — gather, translate, and document laboratory workflows, user needs, and process gaps; convert them into clear functional requirements for IT and vendors. System configuration support — assist with LIMS setup, configuration, validation, and testing activities. User communication & translation — translate technical concepts into simple, actionable guidance for non‑English‑speaking lab staff; translate user questions and issues back to IT. Training & onboarding — support user training sessions, create localized training materials, and ensure adoption of new processes. Issue triage & support — identify, document, and escalate system issues; collaborate with developers and support teams on bug fixes and enhancements. Testing & validation — coordinate and execute UAT, verify system behavior, and ensure compliance with Eurofins quality standards. IT liaison — maintain continuous communication with internal partners and internal IT teams to ensure timely delivery of project milestones. Qualifications 2-3 years of experience in a similar position - preferred experience with ERP- like software, Strong understanding of laboratory workflows or scientific environments is a plus. Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain system related topics to non‑technical users. proficiency in Microsoft Office and Excel, and any prior programming experience would be beneficial, Strong problem‑solving mindset and ownership of tasks. Additional Information The LIMS Implementation Support Engineer will play a key role in deploying a new Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) in our laboratory in İzmir. This is a 6-month temporary position and offers a unique opportunity to play a key role in a strategic digital transformation project. This position combines business analysis, on‑site coordination, and hands‑on system support. The primary responsibility is to act as the bridge between the local laboratory team and central IT teams, other external Eurofins teams, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation.

title: Senior Software Security Engineer - AI Benchmark Development
description: About Gramian Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs. About The Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Security Engineer to develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for advanced AI coding models. You will transform real-world software vulnerabilities, including CVEs, security advisories, and open-source bug reports, into realistic Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages. This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review . You will create tasks that assess whether AI systems can identify vulnerabilities, understand their underlying causes, reproduce security issues, and implement reliable fixes rather than simply recognizing familiar patterns or copying existing patches. The ideal candidate has strong professional software engineering experience, deep practical knowledge of application security, and the ability to independently investigate vulnerabilities and build reproducible testing environments. Engagement Type: Contractor assignment Duration: 3 months Start Date: Expected to start next week Commitment: 40 hours per week Work Arrangement: Fully remote Project Focus: AI coding model training and evaluation, software vulnerability research, and secure patch development. Key Responsibilities Vulnerability Research: Source and investigate real-world vulnerabilities from CVEs, security advisories, bug reports, and open-source repositories Security Classification: Identify and classify vulnerabilities using the most specific applicable CWE and map them to relevant OWASP Top 10 categories where appropriate Vulnerability Reproduction: Reproduce security issues and develop reliable proof-of-vulnerability tests that demonstrate the underlying weakness Benchmark Development: Build Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages and software ecosystems Task Authoring: Write realistic task instructions that describe the security issue without revealing vulnerable code, exploit details, or the expected remediation Environment Setup: Create reproducible Docker-based environments with pinned dependencies, clear setup instructions, and reliable execution procedures Verifier Development: Design and harden automated verifiers to prevent gaming, test manipulation, hardcoded solutions, and overfitting Patch Evaluation: Review and score AI-generated patches and technical reasoning using structured security and engineering rubrics Quality Assurance: Identify tasks that can be solved through superficial pattern matching or copying known upstream patches without understanding the vulnerability Technical Documentation: Document vulnerability context, reproduction steps, expected behavior, patch requirements, test methodology, and review decisions Requirements 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Expert-level proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Python JavaScript / TypeScript Java C / C++ C# Go Rust Ruby PHP Kotlin Swift Strong understanding of software security principles and common vulnerability classes Practical knowledge of CWE, CVE, and OWASP Top 10 Ability to independently reproduce vulnerabilities and develop proof-of-vulnerability tests Hands-on experience with security testing and analysis tools, including: Sanitizers Fuzzers Static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker Ability to create automated tests and reproducible technical evaluation environments Excellent technical writing skills, with the ability to explain complex security issues and remediation requirements clearly Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment

title: Desktop Support
description: Job Title: Desktop Support (DSS) Job Location: Buyukhanli plaza , 34750, Istanbul , Türkiye (5 days onsite) Job Type: Contract Job Description: Key Accountabilities: VIP & Service‑Critical Support Deliver white‑glove IT support to VIP and executive users, ensuring rapid resolution, clear communication, and minimal business disruption. Proactively prioritize and manage VIP incidents and requests in accordance with SLA and business impact. Act as the primary on‑site escalation point for deskside and collaboration‑related issues affecting senior stakeholders. Demonstrate high standards of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality in all interactions with senior stakeholders. Communicate respectfully and clearly, always maintaining a calm and courteous demeanour, especially in high‑pressure situations. Represent IT and the organisation positively through professional behaviour, punctuality, and attention to detail. Support joiners, movers, and leavers (JML) activities in collaboration with relevant IT and business teams. Own on‑site support for Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) and Video Conferencing (VC) rooms

title: AI Solutions Developer
description: Concentrix Hakkında Sektörünün lider markalarından Concentrix, bugünün dijital dünyasında insan odaklı müşteri deneyimleri tasarlıyor ve yönetiyor. Dünyada, 60 ülkede 400 binden fazla çalışanıyla hizmet veren Concentrix, Türkiye’de başta İstanbul, İzmir, Ankara, Van olmak üzere toplam 7 şehirde, 16 bini aşkın çalışan ile müşteri hizmet yönetimi ve deneyiminde fark yaratmaya devam etmektedir. Technology Solutions ekibimize yeni bir çalışma arkadaşı arıyoruz. Çağrı merkezi ve müşteri deneyimi operasyonlarına yönelik yapay zeka, otomasyon ve sistem entegrasyonu çözümleri geliştiriyoruz. Bu çözümleri ihtiyaçlara göre kendi ekibimizle veya teknoloji iş ortaklarımızla birlikte hayata geçiriyoruz. Aramıza katılacak kişinin, iş ihtiyaçlarını teknoloji çözümlerine dönüştürmesi, uygulama ve prototip geliştirmesi, aynı zamanda iş ortaklarıyla yürütülen teknik ve operasyonel süreçlerin takibini üstlenmesi beklenmektedir. Kod yazmayı bilen, AI destekli geliştirme araçlarını etkin kullanan ve ürettiği çözümleri fikir aşamasından canlı kullanıma kadar sahiplenen adaylarla tanışmak isteriz. Temel Sorumluluklar İş birimlerinin ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek uygulama, otomasyon ve prototipler geliştirmek. Yapay zeka ve otomasyon projelerinde geliştirme, test ve devreye alma çalışmalarında görev almak. API ve sistem entegrasyonları üzerinde çalışarak farklı platformların birlikte çalışmasını sağlamak. Yeni teknolojileri ve araçları araştırmak, denemek ve uygun çözümlerin ölçeklenmesine katkıda bulunmak. Teknoloji iş ortaklarıyla teknik ve operasyonel süreçleri yürütmek; teklif, lisans, sipariş ve fatura süreçlerini takip etmek. Yeni iş ortaklarının şirket süreçlerine dahil edilmesi ve gerekli risk değerlendirme süreçlerinde koordinasyona destek olmak. İç ekipler, global ekipler ve iş ortakları arasındaki aksiyonların takibini yaparak sonuçlandırılmasını sağlamak. Aranan Nitelikler Yazılım geliştirme, yapay zeka, otomasyon veya benzeri alanlarda tercihen 2-5 yıl deneyim. Kod yazarak uygulama, otomasyon veya AI tabanlı çözümler geliştirebilmek. Tercihen Python, JavaScript/TypeScript veya benzeri programlama dillerinden en az birinde deneyim sahibi olmak. GitHub Copilot, Cursor veya benzeri AI destekli geliştirme araçlarına aşina olmak. Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI, Power Platform veya UiPath platformlarından en az biri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. REST API, SQL ve sistem entegrasyonlarının temel çalışma prensiplerine hakim olmak. İş ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek teknik çözümlere dönüştürebilmek ve sorunları araştırarak çözebilmek. Farklı ekipler ve iş ortaklarıyla etkin iletişim kurabilmek, birden fazla işi planlı şekilde takip ederek sonuçlandırabilmek. Global ekiplerle çalışabilecek düzeyde yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce bilgisine sahip olmak. Tercihen daha önce geliştirdiği bir uygulama, otomasyon veya AI çözümünü canlı kullanıma almış olmak. GitHub, portföy, GitHub repo, demo uygulama veya canlıya alınmış proje paylaşabilmek. Tercihen Bilgisayar, Yazılım, Endüstri, Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği, Yönetim Bilişim Sistemleri veya ilgili bölümlerden mezun olmak; ya da yazılım/yapay zeka alanında eğitim almış olmak.
